title: Staking Rewards for Cardano (ADA) and TRON (TRX)
notes: First-party launch announcement establishing 1 October 2020 as the launch of eToro's dedicated staking service with ADA and TRX and stating that staked cryptoassets remain the property of eToro users while eToro handles staking on their behalf.

title: Crypto Staking at eToro
notes: Current first-party staking surface documenting active staking, jurisdiction-specific eligibility and assets, monthly network-derived rewards, eToro-retained reward shares, the statement that staked cryptoassets remain users' assets, and liquidity, slashing, network/protocol, market and regulatory risks.

title: eToro launches staking for Solana and Ethereum
notes: First-party expansion announcement documenting Solana and Ethereum staking additions to the existing eToro staking program and supporting continuing product operation and broader proof-of-stake coverage.

title: eToro launches staking for US users
notes: First-party U.S. staking launch announcement documenting a later jurisdictional expansion of eToro's staking service; it is not used to replace the 2020 global dedicated-service launch date.

title: Robinhood Crypto introduces staking in Europe
notes: First-party announcement identifying 15 May 2024 as Robinhood Crypto's first-ever crypto staking launch, initially Solana for European customers, and stating that those customers own their crypto while Robinhood holds it on their behalf.

title: Staking
notes: Current U.S. first-party staking help material documenting SOL, ETH and ADA staking, protocol-derived variable rewards, bonding and unbonding periods, third-party staking partner fees, Robinhood Crypto fees, slashing risk and that rewards are not guaranteed by Robinhood Crypto.

title: Crypto Staking
notes: Current first-party product surface confirming continuing Robinhood Crypto staking availability and current supported staking experience for eligible customers.

title: Robinhood launches stock tokens, reveals Layer 2 blockchain, and expands crypto suite in EU and US
notes: First-party announcement documenting the launch of crypto staking for eligible U.S. customers, initially Ethereum and Solana, while also distinguishing U.S. and European product availability and entities.
